Eat a classic Japanese curry or omurice at a retro Kissaten (coffee shop).
Visit Kinomiya Shrine to see the 2,000-year-old sacred camphor tree.
Stroll along the oceanfront and find a quiet day-use hot spring.
Dinner at a local izakaya in the old town.

name: Ito City
description: Izu Peninsula hot spring resort town featuring Mount Omuro extinct volcano cone and Jogasaki Coast.
notes: Ito City travel hub in Shizuoka Prefecture.

itineraries.name: Coastal Drama and Onsen
itineraries.description: Cliffs, ocean views, and relaxing hot springs.

steps.activity: Hike the Jogasaki Coast and cross the Kadowakizaki Suspension Bridge.
Seafood lunch featuring fresh local catch.
Take the chairlift up Mount Omuro for 360-degree views of Izu and Mt. Fuji.
Explore the historic Tokai-kan hostel in central Ito.
Unwind in a local hot spring (onsen) before dinner.

name: Gotemba City
description: Resort city at the foot of Mount Fuji, famous for Gotemba Premium Outlets and scenic volcano panoramas.
notes: Gotemba City travel hub in Shizuoka Prefecture.

name: Fujinomiya City
description: Mount Fuji gateway featuring Fujisan Hongu Sengen Taisha Shrine and Shiraito Falls.
notes: Fujinomiya City travel hub in Shizuoka Prefecture.

itineraries.name: Classic Day Trip
itineraries.description: The most efficient way to see the highlights of Fujinomiya in one day.

steps.activity: Arrive at the main station and get oriented.
Visit the primary city attraction.
Grab a delicious regional lunch.
Continue exploring the scenic sights.
Relax at a local café before heading back.

name: Numazu City
description: Suruga Bay port city famous for Numazu Deep Sea Aquarium and fresh seafood dining.
notes: Numazu City travel hub in Shizuoka Prefecture.

name: Kofu City
description: Historic home of samurai warlord Takeda Shingen, featuring Maizuru Castle Park and Shosenkyo Gorge.
notes: Kofu City travel hub in Yamanashi Prefecture.

itineraries.name: Classic Day Trip
itineraries.description: The most efficient way to see the highlights of Kofu in one day.

steps.activity: Arrive at the main station and get oriented.
Visit the primary city attraction.
Grab a delicious regional lunch.
Continue exploring the scenic sights.
Relax at a local café before heading back.

name: Fujikawaguchiko Town
description: Premier Mount Fuji viewing resort town centered around Lake Kawaguchiko, Chureito Pagoda, and Fuji-Q Highland.
notes: Fujikawaguchiko Town travel hub in Yamanashi Prefecture.

name: Matsumoto City
description: Alpine castle city featuring National Treasure Matsumoto 'Crow' Castle and gateway to Kamikochi.
notes: Matsumoto City travel hub in Nagano Prefecture.

itineraries.name: Plan A: The Black Castle
itineraries.description: Focus on the historic samurai history of Matsumoto.

steps.activity: Arrive in Matsumoto. Head straight to Matsumoto Castle, one of Japan's oldest.
Have Shinshu Soba for lunch, a local specialty.
Stroll along Nakamachi-dori, known for its historic black-and-white storehouses.
Wander Nawate-dori (Frog Street) for quirky shops and street food.
Visit a local sake brewery for tasting before dinner.

itineraries.name: Plan B: Art & Alps
itineraries.description: A cultural day featuring famous contemporary art and mountain views.

steps.activity: Visit the Matsumoto City Museum of Art to see the permanent Yayoi Kusama exhibition.
Lunch at a trendy cafe near the museum district.
Take a short bus or taxi ride up to Alps Park.
Enjoy panoramic views of the Japan Alps and explore the nature trails.
Head back to town for a cozy dinner.

name: Karuizawa Town
description: Elegant alpine mountain resort town featuring Kyu-Karuizawa Ginza shopping street and Prince Shopping Plaza.
notes: Karuizawa Town travel hub in Nagano Prefecture.

itineraries.name: Plan A: The Classic Resort
itineraries.description: Shopping, dining, and scenic walks in the famous mountain resort.

steps.activity: Rent a bicycle near Karuizawa Station.
Cycle to Kumoba Pond (Swan Lake) for a beautiful nature walk.
Explore the Kyu-Karuizawa Ginza street. Eat local breads and jams.
Cycle to the historic Shaw Memorial Church and the deep forest.
Finish the day shopping at the massive Prince Shopping Plaza outlet mall.

itineraries.name: Plan B: Art & Architecture
itineraries.description: Discover the elegant modern architecture and waterfalls of the area.

steps.activity: Take a bus to the breathtaking Shiraito Falls.
Head to Harunire Terrace for a stylish lunch in the forest.
Walk to the Stone Church and the Karuizawa Kogen Church.
Visit the Hiroshi Senju Museum, a stunning piece of modern architecture.
Relax at the Tombo-no-yu hot springs.

name: Hakuba Village
description: World-famous Japan Alps winter ski resort village celebrated for deep powder snow and alpine peaks.
notes: Hakuba Village travel hub in Nagano Prefecture.

name: Uji City
description: Historic green tea capital south of Kyoto, featuring UNESCO World Heritage Byodoin Temple (10-yen coin temple).
notes: Uji City travel hub in Kyoto Prefecture.

name: Miyazu City
description: Coastal city home to Amanohashidate pine sandbar, ranked among Japan's Three Scenic Views.
notes: Miyazu City travel hub in Kyoto Prefecture.

name: Sakai City
description: Ancient port city famous for Mozu Kofun Burial Mounds (UNESCO) and traditional Japanese kitchen knives.
notes: Sakai City travel hub in Osaka Prefecture.

name: Kobe City
description: Cosmopolitan port city framed by Mt. Rokko, world-famous for Kobe Beef, Harborland, and Arima Onsen.
notes: Kobe City travel hub in Hyogo Prefecture.

name: Himeji City
description: Historic castle city home to UNESCO World Heritage Himeji 'White Heron' Castle and Koko-en Garden.
notes: Himeji City travel hub in Hyogo Prefecture.

name: Nara City
description: Japan's 8th-century capital, renowned for free-roaming sacred deer in Nara Park and Todai-ji Great Buddha.
notes: Nara City travel hub in Nara Prefecture.

name: Ikaruga Town
description: Historic town home to Horyu-ji Temple, containing the world's oldest surviving wooden structures.
notes: Ikaruga Town travel hub in Nara Prefecture.

name: Otsu City
description: Port city on southern tip of Lake Biwa, featuring Ishiyamadera Temple and Enryaku-ji Temple on Mt. Hiei.
notes: Otsu City travel hub in Shiga Prefecture.

name: Hikone City
description: Castle town on Lake Biwa featuring original National Treasure Hikone Castle and Genkyuen Garden.
notes: Hikone City travel hub in Shiga Prefecture.

name: Wakayama City
description: Coastal castle city famous for Wakayama Castle, Kuroshio Seafood Market, and Wakayama ramen.
notes: Wakayama City travel hub in Wakayama Prefecture.

name: Shirahama Town
description: Subtropical resort town famous for white sand beaches, outdoor hot springs, and Engetsuto Island sunset views.
notes: Shirahama Town travel hub in Wakayama Prefecture.

name: Koya Town
description: Sacred mountain monastic complex (Mount Koya / Koyasan), headquarters of Shingon Buddhism and Okunoin cemetery.
notes: Koya Town travel hub in Wakayama Prefecture.

name: Hiroshima City
description: City of Peace and resilience, famous for Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park, Atomic Bomb Dome, and Hiroshima-style Okonomiyaki.
notes: Hiroshima City travel hub in Hiroshima Prefecture.

name: Onomichi City
description: Picturesque hillside port city overlooking the Seto Inland Sea, famous for Senkoji Temple, temple walks, and Shimanami Kaido cycling route.
notes: Onomichi City travel hub in Hiroshima Prefecture.

name: Hatsukaichi City
description: Coastal city encompassing sacred Miyajima Island and UNESCO World Heritage Itsukushima Floating Torii Gate.
notes: Hatsukaichi City travel hub in Hiroshima Prefecture.

name: Okayama City
description: Sunny city featuring Korakuen Garden (Three Great Gardens of Japan), Okayama 'Crow' Castle, and Momotaro folklore.
notes: Okayama City travel hub in Okayama Prefecture.

name: Kurashiki City
description: Preserved canal town featuring Kurashiki Bikan Historical Quarter, willow-lined canals, and Ohara Museum of Art.
notes: Kurashiki City travel hub in Okayama Prefecture.

name: Matsue City
description: Water city on Lake Shinji featuring original wooden Matsue Castle and Lafcadio Hearn historic residence.
notes: Matsue City travel hub in Shimane Prefecture.

name: Izumo City
description: Sacred realm home to Izumo Taisha, one of Japan's oldest and most important Shinto shrines.
notes: Izumo City travel hub in Shimane Prefecture.

name: Tottori City
description: Coastal capital famous for Tottori Sand Dunes (Japan's largest sand dunes) and Sand Museum.
notes: Tottori City travel hub in Tottori Prefecture.

name: Shimonoseki City
description: Strait port city at the tip of Honshu, world-famous for Karato Fish Market and fugu blowfish cuisine.
notes: Shimonoseki City travel hub in Yamaguchi Prefecture.

name: Takamatsu City
description: Gateway to Shikoku on Seto Inland Sea, famous for Ritsurin Garden landscape park and Sanuki Udon noodles.
notes: Takamatsu City travel hub in Kagawa Prefecture.

name: Matsuyama City
description: Largest city in Shikoku, featuring historic Matsuyama Castle atop Mt. Katsuyama and 3,000-year-old Dogo Onsen.
notes: Matsuyama City travel hub in Ehime Prefecture.

name: Kochi City
description: Southern Pacific coastal city featuring original wooden Kochi Castle, Katsurahama Beach, and Hirome Market.
notes: Kochi City travel hub in Kochi Prefecture.

name: Tokushima City
description: Eastern Shikoku city world-famous for Awa Odori summer dance festival and Mount Bizan cable car.
notes: Tokushima City travel hub in Tokushima Prefecture.

name: Naruto City
description: Strait city famous for Naruto Whirlpools, Otsuka Museum of Art, and Naruto Bridge walk.
notes: Naruto City travel hub in Tokushima Prefecture.

name: Fukuoka City
description: Kyushu's largest metropolis, famous for Nakasu yatai food stalls, Hakata Tonkotsu ramen, and Ohori Park.
notes: Fukuoka City travel hub in Fukuoka Prefecture.

name: Kitakyushu City
description: Northern Kyushu port city featuring Kokura Castle, Mojiko Retro district, and Kawachi Wisteria Garden.
notes: Kitakyushu City travel hub in Fukuoka Prefecture.

name: Dazaifu City
description: Ancient administrative center home to Dazaifu Tenmangu Shrine, dedicated to the deity of learning.
notes: Dazaifu City travel hub in Fukuoka Prefecture.

name: Nagasaki City
description: Historic international port city featuring Glover Garden, Dejima Dutch trading post, and Peace Park.
notes: Nagasaki City travel hub in Nagasaki Prefecture.

name: Kumamoto City
description: Historic castle metropolis home to magnificent Kumamoto Castle and Suizenji Jojuen Garden.
notes: Kumamoto City travel hub in Kumamoto Prefecture.

name: Aso City
description: Volcanic basin city inside Mount Aso caldera (one of the world's largest active volcano calderas).
notes: Aso City travel hub in Kumamoto Prefecture.

name: Beppu City
description: Japan's premier hot spring discharge resort, famous for the Seven Hells of Beppu (Jigoku Meguri).
notes: Beppu City travel hub in Oita Prefecture.

name: Yufu City
description: Charming alpine hot spring town (Yufuin) framed by Mount Yufu peak, boutique cafes, and Kinrin Lake.
notes: Yufu City travel hub in Oita Prefecture.

name: Miyazaki City
description: Subtropical resort city on Pacific coast, famous for Aoshima Island, palm trees, and Miyazaki beef.
notes: Miyazaki City travel hub in Miyazaki Prefecture.

name: Takachiho Town
description: Mythological gorge town featuring Takachiho Gorge basalt chasm, boat rentals, and Amano Iwato Shrine.
notes: Takachiho Town travel hub in Miyazaki Prefecture.

name: Kagoshima City
description: Southern coastal city known as 'Naples of Japan', facing active Sakurajima volcano across Kagoshima Bay.
notes: Kagoshima City travel hub in Kagoshima Prefecture.

name: Yakushima Town
description: Subtropical island World Heritage wilderness covered in ancient Yaku cedar forests and mossy gorges.
notes: Yakushima Town travel hub in Kagoshima Prefecture.

name: Sapporo City
description: Hokkaido's vibrant capital metropolis, famous for Sapporo Snow Festival, Odori Park, Susukino, and miso ramen.
notes: Sapporo City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Otaru City
description: Nostalgic canal port town near Sapporo, famous for stone warehouses, glasscraft shops, and fresh seafood sushi.
notes: Otaru City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Hakodate City
description: Southern Hokkaido port city celebrated for Mt. Hakodate night view, Goryokaku star fort, and Morning Market.
notes: Hakodate City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Asahikawa City
description: Hokkaido's second-largest city, home to Asahiyama Zoo, soy ramen, and gateway to Daisetsuzan National Park.
notes: Asahikawa City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Furano City
description: Central Hokkaido floral valley famous for rolling purple lavender fields (Farm Tomita) and winter ski slopes.
notes: Furano City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Biei Town
description: Scenic landscape town renowned for the Shirogane Blue Pond, Patchwork Road hills, and Panoramic Flower Gardens.
notes: Biei Town travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Niseko Town
description: World-class powder snow winter ski resort town framed by Mount Yotei ('Hokkaido's Mt. Fuji').
notes: Niseko Town travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Kushiro City
description: Eastern Hokkaido port city featuring Kushiro Marsh National Park (home to Japanese red-crowned cranes).
notes: Kushiro City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Abashiri City
description: Okhotsk coastal city famous for winter sea drift ice cruise ships (Garinko) and Abashiri Prison Museum.
notes: Abashiri City travel hub in Hokkaido Prefecture.

name: Naha City
description: Okinawa's capital and subtropical gateway, featuring Kokusai-dori shopping boulevard and historic Shuri Castle.
notes: Naha City travel hub in Okinawa Prefecture.

name: Nago City
description: Northern main island city featuring Busena Marine Park, Orion Happy Park brewery, and cherry blossom festivals.
notes: Nago City travel hub in Okinawa Prefecture.

name: Motobu Town
description: Oceanic resort town home to Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium, Emerald Beach, and Bise Fukugi Tree Avenue.
notes: Motobu Town travel hub in Okinawa Prefecture.

name: Ishigaki City
description: Yaeyama archipelago tropical island hub, famous for Kabira Bay turquoise waters, coral reefs, and stargazing.
notes: Ishigaki City travel hub in Okinawa Prefecture.

name: Miyakojima City
description: Island paradise famous for 'Miyako Blue' crystal waters, Yonaha Maehama Beach, and spectacular sea bridges.
notes: Miyakojima City travel hub in Okinawa Prefecture.

name: Nagoya Castle (Golden Shachihoko)
description: Iconic landmark of Nagoya featuring reconstructed Hommaru Palace and golden shachihoko roof ornaments.

name: Hachioji Castle Ruins (Mount Castle)
description: Atmospheric hilltop mountain castle ruins in western Tokyo built by Hojo Ujiteru.

name: Shrines and Temples of Nikko (Toshogu & UNESCO Heritage)
description: UNESCO World Heritage complex housing the lavishly gilded Yomeimon Gate, Tokugawa Ieyasu's mausoleum, and three wise monkeys wood carving.

name: Matsumoto Castle (Crow Castle)
description: Matsumoto Castle (Crow Castle) is one of Japan's 12 original surviving castle keeps.

name: Inuyama Castle (National Treasure Keep)
description: Inuyama Castle (National Treasure Keep) is one of Japan's 12 original surviving castle keeps.
